aura_product: AI-powered design assistant providing personalized beauty recommendations, virtual try-on, and smart search across beauty content. Core capabilities include personalized product recommendations, visual search, virtual try-on, predictive treatment suggestions, and context-aware search. Entry points are the main app interface, provider detail pages, and booking flow integration. Decisions are made by the AURA system with user confirmation for final actions. Information used includes user profile, behavior history, beauty knowledge base, and contextual signals. Services consumed are NVIDIA NV-Embed-QA embedding service, pgvector HNSW vector database, FTS fallback search, and RAG query logging.

rag_pipeline: Canonical path: User query → auraToolExecutor.search_beauty_knowledge() → ragService.searchBeautyKnowledge() (HNSW vector search on 1024d embeddings) → FTS fallback (tsvector/tsquery) if embedding fails → context assembly → LLM response generation → logging to rag_query_logs. Key components: ragService.js (core search with HNSW + FTS fallback), embeddingService.js (NVIDIA NV-Embed-QA 1024d with circuit breaker), chunkingService.js (semantic chunking 500-800 tokens, 50% overlap), circuitBreakerService.js (nvidiaEmbeddings breaker 3 failures/30s cooldown), ragPool (separate connection pool for RAG).
knowledge: Single canonical RAG pipeline with pgvector HNSW index as source of truth. Knowledge sources include beauty_corpus (MD files), SQL seed data (beauty_knowledge_embeddings), and manual content additions. Document structure: each chunk is a semantic unit (500-800 tokens) with metadata (document_id, document_version, chunk_id, content_hash). Versioning tracks active version while preserving historical versions. Quality gates include content hash validation for idempotency, chunk size validation, and metadata completeness checks.
embeddings: Service: NVIDIA NV-Embed-QA (1024-dimension). Process: generateEmbedding(text, 'query') → circuit breaker → success returns vector for retrieval, failure propagates error to ragService for FTS fallback. Storage: embeddings stored in beauty_knowledge_embeddings table (1024d vectors). Circuit breaker: nvidiaEmbeddings with 3 failure threshold / 30s cooldown. Fallback: FTS (tsvector/tsquery) in pgvector when embeddings fail.
retrieval: Primary method: HNSW vector search (pgvector) on 1024d embeddings. Fallback method: FTS (tsvector/tsquery) in pgvector. Retrieval modes: hnsw (primary), fts (fallback), hybrid (when both used). Query parameters: category filters (skincare, cabello, cejas, general), threshold tuning (0.450-0.700), metadata filters (document categories). Logging: full query details stored in rag_query_logs (category, threshold, filters, scores).
evaluation: Datasets: 30-query evaluation dataset (real user queries). Metrics: P@5, R@5, MRR, Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy. Benchmarks: RAGAS metrics with human evaluation. Regression: Tests verify no breaking changes to core pipeline. Current status: 69/69 tests PASS (embeddingService 16, ragLogger 10, ragMetrics 12, ragEvaluator 23, ciRagEvaluation 8).
memory: Query memory: rag_query_logs with full traceability. Embedding memory: beauty_knowledge_embeddings with content_hash and document_id. State memory: No persistent state beyond query logs and embeddings. Eviction policy: LRU-based on query frequency and recency.
decision_authority: User: final confirmation for actions (booking, payment, treatment selection). System (Aura Orchestrator): decides retrieval path and response generation. AURA: determines personalized recommendations and interface presentation. Agent: executes specific tasks within defined scope (e.g., search, booking flow). Human confirmation required for payment processing, treatment selection (critical decisions), and booking finalization.
dependency_map: USER → AURA Product Experience → Aura Orchestrator → RAG Pipeline → Embeddings → Vector Database → LLM → RESPONSE → USER

duplicate_intelligence.duplicate_detection: Multiple RAG paths: only one canonical path exists. Multiple embedding services: only NVIDIA NV-Embed-QA used in production. No duplicated knowledge sources - single corpus with centralized ingestion.

risks: Model dependency: NVIDIA API availability critical for embeddings
Vendor lock-in: NVIDIA API dependency with no immediate alternative
Undocumented prompts: System prompts centralized but not fully version-controlled
RAG gaps: FTS fallback may not cover all semantic queries
Data leakage risk: Embedding data stored in vector DB with metadata
Hallucination risk: LLM responses based on retrieved context
Unclear ownership: Ambiguous responsibility for specific components
